pickaxeRadiusMultiplier.label: Pickaxe Radius
pickaxeRadiusMultiplier.description: The pickaxe digs this many times wider (x3 digs a 27 times bigger volume per hit). Bombs and enemy attacks keep their size. 1 keeps the game's own radius. Only in worlds you host.

rakeRadiusMultiplier.label: Rake Radius
rakeRadiusMultiplier.description: The rake flattens an area this many times wider. 1 keeps the game's own radius. Only in worlds you host.

changelog: 1.0.0: first version: Pickaxe Radius and Rake Radius multipliers, the two Advanced Terrain Edit features in use, without its other tools.
